sample: Twelve previously viewed SUN RGB-D laptop/table and bottle/table scenes: eight RGB-positive and four RGB-negative annotated pairs; not held out from project inspection.
visual_input: Original RGB image with annotated child 2D box outlined red and annotated table 2D box outlined green; no depth, 3D coordinates, masks, or correctness labels in prompt.
prompt: In this image, the red box marks object A and the green box marks object B. Is A physically resting on B? Answer exactly YES, NO, or UNCERTAIN. 'On' means A is supported by B, not just nearby or visually overlapping. Ignore other surfaces.
parsing: Read the first generated token after trimming whitespace and punctuation. Accept only YES, NO or UNCERTAIN; mark all other text as unparseable, never silently coerce it to YES.
primary_metric: Pair-level YES/NO/UNCERTAIN confusion counts against RGB labels, denominator all twelve scenes. Report unparsable responses and category splits. No prompt tuning on these scenes.
claim_limits: Oracle boxes identify the annotated pair. Small previously inspected set and single human annotator. This is a VLM feasibility check, not a held-out relation or final pipeline result.
